headline: Production Supervisor
summary: Production supervisor with twelve years in sugar and food manufacturing in Iloilo. I run a plant of 150 workers across three shifts, set up new lines and products, tune automated process controls and machine speeds, and keep quality and safety under control. I work closely with supply chain and inventory teams to keep lines running.
highlights: Raised line efficiency from 71% to 86% on the main packing line in two years.
Commissioned a new juice line and brought two new products to full production in four months.
Achieved 1.5 million work hours without a lost-time injury.

experience.title: Production Supervisor
experience.employer: Passi Valley Sugar and Food Products Corp.
bullets: Supervise 150 operators and 6 shift leaders across sugar packing and juice lines.
Set line speeds and control settings to match product specs and demand.
Lead daily production meetings on output, quality, safety and downtime.

experience.title: Production Shift Leader
bullets: Led a shift of 40 on snack production and packing lines.
Coordinated raw material supply with the warehouse to avoid stoppages.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering
